mathematics.assertion_tested: A_0009(x) agrees with independently enumerated Independent-Set existence until the first disagreement, then stops and preserves the exact witness
mathematics.coefficient_domain: exact integer energy; Float64 coordinates restricted to exactly represented zero and one
mathematics.conventions: JSON-IS-1; vertex order from ids; numeric edge-pair order; one-bit descent ties by (energy,index); invalid encodings are outside language
inputs: all labeled simple graphs in ascending vertex count, edge-mask order and target order up to the first mismatch

bounds.graphs: edge-mask order over lexicographically ordered pairs
bounds.stop: first mismatch; no later graph or bridge attacked

non_claims: No proof of P=NP or P!=NP
No numeric Turing-machine runtime constant certified
No implicit use of the bounded combinations oracle inside A
